# `aitbc blockchain restore`

Restore a chain from a backup file on a target node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain restore [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--backup-file` | path | — | yes | The Backup file. |
| `--node` | text | — | no | Target node for restoration |
| `--verify` | flag | `false` | no | Verify restoration |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain restore --backup-file <backup_file>
```
